evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast: unrehearsed rollback set against rollback we do not have — matched grammatical structure across two clauses doing argumentative work.
Recurring organizational formula naming a cadence and practice — the kind of signature phrasing that functions as a stock-phrase within this org's vocabulary.

mints.name: UnrehearsedAsNonexistent
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the argument here collapsing the gap between preparation and possession — equating what is unrehearsed with what does not exist?
